freeze_status: Frozen while the development-only job was pending and before development-gate results or blind HER values were inspected.
eligibility: Run only if the independently verified development gate sets blind_release_allowed=true.

training.donor_properties: Exactly the source-only admitted properties recorded before development modeling
training.feature_form: Exactly the raw-or-rank form selected by the development gate

primary_endpoint.metric: paired relative reduction in log1p-HER RMSE versus target_structure_only
primary_endpoint.summary: mean of the 100 draw-specific paired relative RMSE gains
primary_endpoint.independent_experimental_unit: blind molecule, with dependence clustered by canonical Bemis-Murcko scaffold
primary_endpoint.computational_replication: The 100 outcome-independent label-budget draws quantify training-set uncertainty and are not counted as 100 additional experimental samples.

uncertainty.procedure: For each replicate, sample blind scaffolds with replacement and sample the 100 label-budget draws with replacement; preserve method pairing and include every molecule belonging to each sampled scaffold.
uncertainty.interval: percentile 95 percent confidence interval for relative RMSE gain

tests.cluster_statistic: For each scaffold, sum the squared-error improvement of the candidate over its matched baseline after averaging over label-budget draws; randomly flip scaffold signs.
comparison_family: selected donor versus target structure only
selected donor versus matched shuffled donor
calculated plus selected donor versus calculated only
tests.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three named comparisons

prediction: average precision at HER at least 1.07 micromol per hour
average precision at HER at least 12.5 micromol per hour
exploration: experiments required to recover 25 and 50 percent of high-activity molecules
performance as a function of donor support

missing_data: No blind molecule may be removed after outcome access. Calculated-descriptor missing values use the corresponding labeled-development training median within each draw; an all-missing training column is set to zero.
reporting: Report all frozen methods, scopes and endpoints regardless of direction. Exact molecule counts and scaffold counts are reported for every scope.
claim_guard: Passing the full gate establishes one retrospective neighboring experimental-database edge for molecular photocatalytic OOD prediction. It does not establish prospective laboratory discovery, universality across photocatalysis, or a mechanism.
